pages.text:
A steel chamber of Pressure Glass with a grow lamp inside. It grows the same crops as the Glass Cloche, 3 times as fast, with FE and water.
- 24 FE/t while it grows, and 100 mB of water a harvest.
- Soil, seed and fertilizer slots work like the Glass Cloche's.
- Its faces can be set in the Sides tab: by default items and water go in the top, the harvest comes out of the bottom (turn on auto-eject), and FE goes in the back.
- Speed upgrades make it faster (and draw FE just as much faster); Energy upgrades cut the FE.
The lamp lights up while it grows.
